verdict.rationale: Independent Phoronix Linux compute testing ran 60+ CUDA/OptiX/OpenCL benchmarks on the RTX 5090, and Llama.cpp benchmarks also ran on it, so CUDA compute workloads demonstrably run on this part. NVIDIA's CUDA Toolkit docs describe the compiler, runtime, libraries and Nsight tooling, and the RTX developer page ties Blackwell Tensor Cores to PyTorch/TensorFlow work. However, none of the cited docs explicitly list the RTX 5090 or Blackwell compute capability as a supported CUDA target. missing for 10: an explicit CUDA documentation entry listing the RTX 5090 or its compute capability as supported, and first-party confirmation of the minimum CUDA/driver version for this part.
